mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors become risk-averse, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS above 5.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 4.2% and PAYEMS growth accelerates (> 200k new jobs), a strong labor market boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of instances with jointly triggered labor market conditions, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.05 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 2-month increase in INDPRO, indicating strengthening industrial production, signals improved corporate earnings prospects, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of sustained INDPRO growth.

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST exceeds 1900k units, indicating a strong housing market, consumer spending and confidence increase, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of instances with HOUST above 1900k, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when FEDFUNDS is below 4.5% and CPIAUCSL growth decelerates (< 2% YoY), a benign inflation environment with accommodative monetary policy leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical monetary policy and inflation trends
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of instances with jointly triggered monetary and inflation conditions, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.05 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in UNRATE below 4.5% without a corresponding increase in PAYEMS (> 100k new jobs) may indicate labor market imbalances, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 40% of instances with jointly triggered labor market conditions, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.05 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS exceeds $370 billion, indicating strong retail sales, consumer confidence and spending increase, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during the holiday season (Nov-Jan).
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of holiday season instances with RSAFS above $370 billion, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
